projectDetail.projectName: Destruction of Legacy Ozone-Depleting Substances from Refrigeration Systems in Israel
projectDetail.projectDescription: This project effectively reduces environmental risks from legacy refrigerants, aligning with global climate action and making a positive contribution to the Sustainable Development Goals from the United Nations. Project protects the ozone layer through the safe destruction of ozone-depleting refrigerants, mainly R11 and R12, with traces of other ACR's methodology eligible refrigerants. These potent high Global Warming Potential GHGs, sourced from obsolete refrigeration systems, present considerable environmental hazards if not managed appropriately. The refrigerant gases are collected at a facility operated by Electra Recycling and All Trade, with destruction activities conducted at the ECOSOL facility in Neot-Hovav, Israel, operating under the Montreal Protocol's TEAP standards. Oporto Carbon owns carbon rights and oversees project registration, while Recycling Electra and All Trade jointly manage collection and recycling processes. D13C acts as the marketer of the credits generated.
projectDetail.projectMethodologyName: Destruction of Ozone Depleting Substances (ODS) from International Sources

projectDetail.projectDescription: The Alliance Dairy Project is a dairy digester system that was built to capture the biogas from dairy manure, the majority of which would have been stored in an uncovered anaerobic lagoon and in long-term solids storage under aerobic conditions prior to project implementation. The biogas that is captured from the digester system is used to generate electricity through one generator. Any excess biogas not combusted by the gen-sets is combusted in an open flare. Biogas produced by the digester is monitored continuously using thermal mass flowmeters.
projectDetail.projectMethodologyName: ARB Compliance Offset Protocol: Capturing and Destroying Methane from Manure Management Systems
